Acceptance_Criteria: Deutsch DTM 4-way sealed family used or approved equivalent
CAN-H mapped to cavity 1 and correct circuit ID
CAN-L mapped to cavity 2 and correct circuit ID
Service ground mapped correctly and not used as high-current return
Protected service +12V fitted and labelled or explicitly DNP/sealed
Finished service stub <=300 mm unless engineering deviation approved
CAN-H/L remain twisted through trunk and service branch as far as practical
No CAN-H/CAN-L reversal end-to-end
No H/L short to each other +12V ground shield or unrelated circuits
Selected CAN port termination configuration documented
PMU16 termination configuration documented
Every fitted 120-ohm termination explicitly identified
CAN-H to CAN-L resistance agrees with documented topology; approx 60 ohm when two 120-ohm endpoint terminators are intentionally present
X51 contains no permanent undocumented termination resistor
CAN separated from ignition/injector/starter/pump high-current noise sources
Stable bidirectional/required CAN communication after configuration
No harness-induced CAN fault during cranking
No harness-induced CAN fault with SparkPRO/coils operating
External service device cannot back-feed vehicle through optional X51 power
CAN-001 through applicable CAN-019 PASS
